note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI deep struck Stormboyz onto its own home objective, which it already holds with 35 OC. This wastes the fast deep-strike unit. Fix: Score arrive_objectives by marginal gain only. Count it when the unit flips or contests an objective, or when the objective is held with thin OC. Give zero value to an objective already held with a large OC margin and no enemy nearby. Add a bonus for arriving at an enemy-held or neutral objective. Remove options with no legal spot before ranking.
